## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Claude Desktop 使用代理时原生配置窗口显示 “Couldn’t load configuration” 和 “Couldn’t update saved configurations” 的问题。实例使用的代理配置现在同步登记到原生配置列表，配置窗口可读取和保存当前配置。
- 兼容旧版恢复记录中的未登记配置；切换网络或 API 连接时恢复配置列表与选中项，保留客户端中新建、复制、另选或修改的原生配置及扩展字段。没有先前配置时，保留可用的原生条目，避免留下无法读取的空配置目录。
- API / 第三方实例在尚未设置 Developer 偏好时初始化原生入口，可通过 **Developer → Configure Third-Party Inference…** 打开连接配置。已有明确关闭的偏好继续保留，组织策略和受限账号规则仍由 Claude 执行。客户端内登录实例保持原生偏好。

- Fixed “Couldn’t load configuration” and “Couldn’t update saved configurations” in Claude Desktop's native configuration window when an instance uses a proxy. The active proxy configuration is now registered in the native configuration list so the editor can read and save it.
- Older recovery records with unlisted configurations remain compatible. Changing networks or API connections restores the configuration list and selection while preserving native configurations created, copied, selected or edited in the client, including extension fields. When no earlier configuration exists, recovery retains an available native entry instead of leaving an unreadable empty catalogue.
- API / third-party instances now initialize the native Developer menu when no preference has been set, making connection settings available under **Developer → Configure Third-Party Inference…**. Explicit disabled preferences are retained, and Claude continues to enforce organization and restricted-account policies. Instances using sign-in inside the client keep their native preference.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

v0.12.1 提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时，关闭窗口或普通退出会保留后台服务；请完成当前任务，等待实例与管理器彻底退出后再安装新版。旧管理器仍在后台时，打开新包会重新显示旧窗口；以侧栏底部的版本为准。升级后再次启动 Claude Desktop 实例时应用新的准备与恢复逻辑。

账号、实例、会话和本地设置保留，内部存储身份与已有数据目录保持兼容。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

v0.12.1 provides DMG / ZIP packages for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the window or using ordinary Quit keeps background services alive while instances are running. Finish active work and wait for the instances and manager to exit completely before installing. If an older manager remains in the background, opening a new bundle returns to the old window; check the sidebar version. The updated preparation and recovery behavior applies when a Claude Desktop instance is next launched after upgrading.

Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained, with the same internal storage identity and compatible data directories. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 Claude 订阅 OAuth 和 API Key / Bearer 连接，以及 macOS Claude Desktop 的客户端内登录或用于 Code / Cowork 的 API / 第三方连接。客户端需单独安装。Anthropic Messages 网关可用于 Desktop API 与 CLI，额度查询按配置协议进入供应商链路。云模式和 npm 包装启动器仍未接入。

Desktop 实例分别保存 Cookie、配置、加密状态文件与本地历史，共用当前 macOS 用户的系统钥匙串服务；同账号的云端历史仍可同步。客户端内登录使用管理器设置中的默认网络，API / 第三方连接还支持所选连接的账号代理覆盖；Code 用户自定义环境仍可能覆盖默认网络。Desktop 会话在客户端中管理，管理器暂不索引或迁移；CLI 会话管理只读。Codex 官方账号的原生桌面启动使用原版界面；API 桌面模式的菜单和语言兼容取决于客户端能力，Fast / Ultra 还取决于模型和服务商。

Supported clients include Codex desktop / CLI, the official native Claude Code CLI on macOS with Claude subscription OAuth or API Key / Bearer connections, and Claude Desktop on macOS with sign-in inside the client or API / third-party connections for Code / Cowork. Install clients separately. Anthropic Messages gateways work with Desktop API and CLI connections, and usage checks follow the configured protocol through the provider integration. Cloud modes and npm wrapper launchers remain unintegrated.

Desktop instances keep separate cookies, configuration, encrypted state files and local history while sharing the current macOS user's system Keychain service. Cloud history for the same account can still sync. Sign-in inside the client uses the manager's default network; API / third-party connections also support the selected connection's account proxy override. Custom Code environments can still override the default network. Manage Desktop sessions inside the client; the manager does not index or migrate them. CLI session management is read-only. Codex native account desktop instances use the original client UI; API desktop menu and language integration depends on client capabilities. Fast / Ultra also depend on the model and provider.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本机全量回归 1,375 项通过、4 项跳过；类型检查、源码构建、代理服务测试、管理器界面和退出后保留实例验收通过。官方 Desktop 的本机 API / Bearer 凭据轮换与切换客户端内登录也已通过隔离验收。

针对性回归已通过，覆盖原生配置列表登记、旧恢复记录兼容、网络与 API 配置叠加、原生修改和新增条目保留，以及恢复后的选中项与重复执行。测试使用隔离目录和合成配置，不读取真实账号凭据。

在未修改签名的官方 Claude Desktop 2.42304.0 上，使用临时实例和本机 Messages 模拟服务复现了两条配置错误，并验证补齐登记后同一进程点击 Retry 恢复、原生编辑保存及重新启动后读回修改。配置的测试代理处理外部网络尝试，测试进程在结束后清理。

这些检查不代表已完成真实账号的 Desktop 登录、Chat / Code / Cowork 或订阅服务端到端请求，也不代表任意网关、套餐或客户端版本均兼容。构建记录和安装包校验清单见下方链接。

The full local suite passed 1,375 tests with four skips. Type checks, source builds, proxy service tests, manager UI checks and instance survival after manager Quit passed. Isolated official Desktop checks also passed API / Bearer credential rotation against a local service and switching to sign-in inside the client.

Targeted regression checks passed for native configuration registration, compatibility with older recovery records, combined network and API configurations, retention of native edits and new entries, and selection and repeated execution after recovery. Tests use isolated directories and synthetic configuration without reading real account credentials.

On the unmodified signed official Claude Desktop 2.42304.0, a temporary instance and loopback Messages service reproduced both configuration errors. Restoring the missing entry recovered the editor through Retry in the same process; native edits saved successfully and remained readable after restart. The configured test proxy handled external network attempts, and test processes were cleaned up afterward.

These checks do not establish end-to-end real-account Desktop sign-in, Chat / Code / Cowork or subscription requests, or compatibility with every gateway, plan or client release. Build records and installer checksums are linked below.
